how: Same logic as home_dashboard() in server.py, run once per input set: Retriever.search(query, k=len(chunks), balance=False) over data/epictetus.json; 'voice' chunks first ('voice'+'life' only if no voice chunk qualifies); passage = _trim_passage(chunk text), unedited; the app stops after the first 3 clean ones (these are the 'top 3 considered'); pick = sha256(day + mentor_key) mod (number of candidates considered). The pick depends only on the day and mentor, so with 3 candidates it is the same slot for every situation, while the passage in that slot differs. No model or API call.
